title: A bill to designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 20 Ferry Road in Saunderstown, Rhode Island, as the "Captain Matthew J. August Post Office".
official_summary: Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 20 Ferry Road in Saunderstown, Rhode Island, as the "Captain Matthew J. August Post Office."

summary.headline: Congress renamed a post office in Saunderstown, Rhode Island, after Captain Matthew J. August.
summary.what_it_does: This law names the United States Postal Service facility at 20 Ferry Road in Saunderstown, Rhode Island, the "Captain Matthew J. August Post Office." It changes only the official name of the building. It does not change mail service, postal rules, or how the office operates.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 13, 2018.
